bearing.gui.schematicannon.option.dontRe: Solid blocks already inside the build area are left alone; only air and non-solid blocks get overwritten.
bearing.gui.schematicannon.option.replac: A solid block in the build area gets overwritten whenever the schematic has any block at that spot.
Every block in the build area gets overwritten, and spots that are air in the schematic are emptied.
A solid block in the build area gets overwritten only when the schematic also has a solid block at that spot.
bearing.gui.schematicannon.option.skipBl: Blocks that store data, like chests, are never overwritten.
bearing.gui.schematicannon.option.skipMi: When a needed block can't be found in storage, that spot is skipped and printing moves on.

bearing.schematic.tool.deploy.descriptio: Puts the schematic preview somewhere new.
Right-click a block surface to set it down.
Hold [Ctrl] to aim at a set distance in the air.
Scroll while holding [Ctrl] to adjust that distance.
Mirrors the schematic across the face you aim at.
Aim at the schematic, hold [CTRL] and scroll to mirror it.

Aim at the schematic, hold [CTRL] and scroll to slide it.
bearing.schematic.tool.print.description: Builds the structure in the world right away.
[Right-Click] to build it where it currently sits.
bearing.schematic.tool.rotate.descriptio: Turns the schematic about its center point.
Hold [CTRL] and scroll to turn it in 90° steps.

item.bearing.schematic.tooltip.summary: Carries a saved structure. Line up its hologram where you want it, then let a _Schematicannon_ build it.

Brings up a _screen_ where you can type in exact _coordinates_.
item.bearing.schematic_and_quill.tooltip: Stores a chosen _region_ of the world as an _.nbt file_.
_R-Click_ two opposite _corners_. Hold _Ctrl_ and scroll to place a corner in the air.
Aim at a face and _Ctrl-Scroll_ to grow or shrink the box; R-Click once more to save.
block.bearing.schematic_table.tooltip.su: Turns an _Empty Schematic_ into a filled one from a file you saved.
block.bearing.schematic_table.tooltip.be: Pick a file from your schematics folder to upload.
block.bearing.schematicannon.tooltip.sum: Fires blocks to build a deployed _Schematic_ in the world, pulling items from nearby inventories and burning _Gunpowder_.
Hang it on a _wall_ to _lay out_ _recipe_ _patterns_ that make crafting by hand quicker. Each slot holds one recipe.
